analyst_view.overall: Early view: Elche have the worst home record in the league (1 point from 18 at the Martínez Valero) despite good away form, and Martín Anselmi is dealing with injuries to Lemar, Aguado and others. Atlético play Viking at home in the Champions League three days earlier, so Simeone may rotate, and Cuti Romero's new muscle injury may still keep him out.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Elche have scored little at home (losing 0-1 to Valencia and 0-2 to Betis), and Atlético had one of the two best defences in the first ten rounds. A low-scoring Atlético win is the most likely result.

corners.text: The site expects 9.3 corners. Elche like to keep the ball, even at home, and won nine corners against Betis, while Atlético take their share from set-piece pressure. Ten corners looks fair.

cards.text: The model has 4.2 cards. Elche took four yellows against Betis and Atlético four against Barcelona; Simeone's team slows games down with fouls when ahead. I lean to five cards.

shots.text: The site expects 27.1 shots and I see no strong reason to move it. Elche had 13 shots against Betis and Atlético usually take a similar number away, though a rotated side after Viking could be less sharp.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 on target. None of Elche's 13 shots against Betis went in and their creative midfielders are injured, and Atlético away often take few, careful shots. About seven on target.
